name: Pairwise Constraint Disguise
description: Replaced the explicit "no two share the same coordinate" exact-cover phrasing with a pairwise algebraic constraint (product of absolute differences > 0). This makes the problem look like a k-Clique problem on a generic graph. Models that pattern-match will write a generic clique solver and TLE due to the large branching factor, while models that genuinely reason will deduce that the constraint implies a permutation of coordinates, recognize the Exact Cover structure, and apply the necessary pruning (or DLX) to pass.
